finding_reviews.finding_contains: Solidity function `withdraw` can truncate `shares` in cast to `uint128`

finding_reviews.finding_contains: Solidity function `transferFrom` is an externally callable state-mutating function with no access-control guard
finding_reviews.reason: ERC20 transferFrom is authorized by the allowance, not by an owner check. The planted defect here (SOL01-D02, unchecked allowance underflow) is not what the finding describes.

finding_reviews.finding_contains: Solidity function `bid` may be vulnerable to reentrancy
finding_reviews.reason: The refund call to the previous highestBidder runs before highestBidder/highestBid are updated. That bidder can re-enter bid() and be refunded the same highestBid twice. The planted SOL02-D01 is the related refund DoS on the same call.

finding_reviews.finding_contains: TypeScript function `handlePatch` uses `task` (from `.find(...)`)
finding_reviews.reason: `if (!task) return sendJson(res, 404, ...)` runs right after the find.

finding_reviews.finding_contains: TypeScript function `handlePatch` indexes with the result of `.indexOf(
finding_reviews.reason: handlePatch awaits the request body between find and indexOf, and replaces the task object. A concurrent PATCH of the same task makes indexOf return -1, so `tasks[-1] = updated` silently drops one update. The ground truth does not list this.

finding_reviews.finding_contains: Go function `reorderPoint` can divide by `int32(len(locations))`
finding_reviews.reason: On the fixed code, reorderPoint returns 0 when locations is empty, so the divisor is never zero.

finding_reviews.finding_contains: Rust function `charge_fee` can truncate `cents` in cast to `u64`
finding_reviews.reason: On the fixed code, charge_fee rejects cents <= 0 before the cast, so the i64 value is always in u64 range.
